steps.name: Flipkart Grievance Officer
steps.when_to_use: If initial customer support fails to resolve the issue regarding the defective product or return process.
steps.timeline: check the timeline in Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules, 2020, Rule 6(4)
steps.typical_wait: check the timeline in Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules, 2020, Rule 6(4)

steps.name: National Consumer Helpline (NCH)
steps.channel: Call 1915, NCH App, or Web Portal (consumerhelpline.gov.in)
steps.when_to_use: If the company fails to resolve the grievance within the stipulated time.

steps.name: District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission
steps.when_to_use: If the issue remains unresolved after exhausting internal and helpline channels.

note: Ensure you have all evidence ready, including order details, photos of the defective product, and records of your previous communication with Flipkart, before escalating to the Consumer Commission.
notes: replaced timeline “1 month” of “Flipkart Grievance Officer”: its source does not state it
